products.title: Joyful Things Bundle

products.title: Colombia La Montaña Pink Bourbon
products.body_html:
Pink Bourbon likely gets its name from its pale, pinkish cherries and its discovery amid a thick crop of Bourbon plants. Genetic testing in 2023 revealed it’s a mutation of an Ethiopian heirloom variety, though how it reached Colombia remains a mystery.

Producers across the country have taken note of its cup quality, and some exceptional lots have emerged. Stumptown is excited to bring you this 100% Pink Bourbon lot from the La Montaña group.

products.title: Kenya Karumandi
products.body_html: The Karumandi Coffee Factory sits just south of Mount Kenya amid emerald green fields of tea and countless small coffee farms. The nutrient-rich red volcanic soil, cool climate of the high elevation, and the fresh water of the Thiba River provide idyllic conditions for coffee cultivation. Coffee thrives in this region of Kenya and the staff of Karumandi are stewards to some of its best coffee.
